name: Serizawa Kuon
source:
Romantic Stance: Expresses her feelings directly
Emotion towards protagonist: Thinks "He shares similar features with me" 

First year high school student, who was brought up at a wealthy household. Moved to Shirasagi town, 1 month earlier than the protagonist.

Is quick witted and also has excellent grades. Although has talent in creation of art, is lacking in cooking and also bad with insects.

Tackles everything with confidence. Is not hesitant in approaching anyone.

"I like it. The innocent part of you, is cute.."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=903610]Getchu[/url]]
